evidence.tripo_builds: both built once ($0.40 each), both one clean figure; A1's long cape came out as its own shell standing clear of the legs in both side views (eyes on look/raw_A1_strip.png)

why: Both sheets build. A2 is the simpler build (mirror IoU 0.87 vs 0.72, 3D IoU 0.839 vs 0.824) -- but the gap is mostly the back view, where A1's cape covers the legs by design, not drift. A1 was picked because its cape BUILT the way the panel-split skin needs: a separate shell hanging free of the legs, with the side panels' slits partly carried into the geometry, so the R-C9-113 3D note (a long cape on the 24-bone rig) can be tested rather than avoided; and the long cape is part of Matt's look (R-C9-113). A2 is kept for Matt's look beside it.
a_first_calls: DK-A1 and DK-A2 first calls came back on a dark plate and drifted (A1's back panel hung from the belt in back view but from the shoulders in front view; A2's front pauldron gained a lame); Astra retried each itself.
